text: During construction, how is the raw recurrent matrix rescaled to a target spectral radius rho?
choices: Divide every entry by the reservoir size N
Compute rho0 = max|eig(W_tilde)|, then set W_rec = (rho / rho0) * W_tilde
Subtract the mean of the entries so the matrix has zero trace
Normalize each row so its entries sum to rho
explanation: Construction computes rho0, the largest eigenvalue magnitude of the raw matrix, then rescales W_rec = (rho/rho0)*W_tilde so that rho(W_rec) = rho exactly (scaling all weights scales all eigenvalues). Dividing by N, zero-centering the trace, or row-normalizing do not set the spectral radius.
